reason: The intent asks to hard-exclude (operation exclude, strength none) videos in which a person is shown eating. Each item was assessed on its own evidence. Item 61004 directly supports the intent: its caption says a mechanic cleans a bicycle chain 'between bites of a sandwich', which describes someone eating even though the category is Repair. The Cooking items (61001, 61002, 61009) show recipes, baking or dinner preparation; food preparation does not establish that anyone eats on camera, so the relationship is too weak to select them. Item 61003 (street food, night market) describes a walk between stalls; it does not state that anyone eats, so it is also a weak relationship and is not selected. The other items (repair, rail, music, untitled clip) have no evidence of eating. The request contains no negation. Selection is a review proposal and does not execute the control.
